prior: original four-family TRAIN generator; original parameters and per-image maximum normalization; no hole-count labels

physics.noise: original differential RMS at20dB, fixed from anchor, never candidate rescaled

calibration.source: 64 distinct TRAIN parents; no y, clean response, dev truth, MAE, or test metadata used
calibration.persistent_structure_rule: At least three of five normalized excursion thresholds have mean-over-scales occupancy disagreement >=0.05. Report components/holes separately; no forced topology-count difference.
calibration.dc_policy: DC is reported independently and removed from continuous shape metric; DC alone cannot qualify novelty.
calibration.jitter_status: 256 existing TRAIN image diagnostic transforms, non-generator interpolation, not P0_EXACT and excluded from proposal reservoir
calibration.threshold_role: Parent must freeze exact joint acceptance semantics before E1; these are data-independent calibration scales, not an existence certificate

structure.joint_rule: all three calibrated minima AND persistent disagreement >=.05 on >=3/5 thresholds AND >=6 cells of normalized rho change >=.1; DC excluded from centered shape

E1.purpose: offline benchmark construction, not free online discoveries
E1.anchors: first fresh reservoir parent of each family: shell/ring, asymmetric/weak, smooth/weak, mixed/ring
E1.round1: rank 128 exact local generator secants using paid exact material J; full-evaluate 3 local +3 independent global reservoir endpoints
E1.round2: refresh exact J at closest structurally qualified first-round local endpoint; rank128 local parameter changes relative fixed original anchor; full-evaluate6
E1.remaining12: only nonzero .02 parameter-range prior-local perturbation of an actually qualifying closest pair
E1.repeat_competition: both noise balls and |Delta ell|<=log(10) on at least16/32 fixed noises separately for each endpoint truth; log100 sensitivity only
E1.E2_requires: two parent-disjoint exact-P0 pairs satisfying structural, d_pred<=2 and repeated competition; no obvious extreme-parameter or numerical defect

material_accounting: 256 fresh generator parents +256 diagnostic transforms +up to1024 generator secants +up to12 robustness perturbations <=1548; repeated rendering of an identical rho in another known background is not a new parent

access_isolation.E1_material_reservoir: OFFLINE_ONLY_BENCHMARK_CONSTRUCTION; all 256 endpoints/parameters withheld from any E2 online view
access_isolation.E2_if_qualified: new independent public TRAIN-distribution reservoir (additional <=256 parents, within2048) + observations/noise/N3 only; no offline E1 files or witness identifiers
access_isolation.historical_development_truth: offline audit/evaluator only; never proposal ranking

preexecution_revision: 1.1: strengthen E1 private-reservoir isolation before first physics attempt
